title: Crank Binding Ended Event
description: A crank stopped existing: its Candybar is archived and its manifest removed. reason explicit: an operator ended it (pj crank detach). session_end: the agent's SessionEnd hook. superseded: the same process started another session (/clear). disabled: crank was turned off for the project. pane_closed: zellij no longer lists the pane. orphan_reaped: the agent process vanished with no session end (reboot, crash, a hook that never fired), i.e. the crank was terminated non-explicitly.

ordering_key.description: §11.1 bucket binding:<name>: every fact of one crank, in order.

binding.description: The crank's name, crank-<cli>-<sid8>-<pid>; also its Candybar name.

cli.description: Agent CLI: claude, codex, kimi, opencode, ...

pid.description: The agent process the crank is bound to (with its start time).

pane_id.description: Where the session lived when bound: location only, never identity.

detail.description: One line on what was seen.
